title: Hospital hell PT 1
content: (For context this is a real dream I've had and is not made up) This dream I awoke in a hospital bed. As I looked down at my body I had scars under my boobs and on each side like my organs were harvested. I started freaking out and the doctors tried to calm me down saying everything was fine. I knew nothing was fine. How did I get to one of the top floors were surgery rooms were in this 12 floor hospital. I've been in the lower levels in other dreams and visited dying family members, ran into scary people and been chased by psychos. But this dream was different. The doctors finally abducted me and stole organs from me. I freaked tf out and remembered there was a pool below beside the hospital for physiotherapy. So I made the rash decision of running through a glass window and falling 12 stories into a pool butt naked. So I braced myself and ran. I thought to myself on the way down I hope I jumped far enough or I'm gunna go splat on the cement. I made it to the pool and swam to the edge and got out. There was a tiki&towel bar by the hospital I apologized for being naked and asked for a towel. As I went to cover my fucked up scarred body I woke up. I will never forget that hospital, its elevator or the endlessness about it. I wasnt gunna chance the falling elevator or them drugging me in a elevator and operating on me again.
